form.email: Type an e-mail address, like name@example.com.

roleLine.customer-buyer: Orders and reorders, production and urgent orders, quotes, deliveries and documents.
roleLine.customer-quality: Certificates, test reports, complaints and returns; reads orders in production.
roleLine.customer-designer: Samples, artwork and approvals of designs.
roleLine.customer-production: Orders in production: stages, dates and what waits for them; approvals and urgent orders; no prices.
roleLine.customer-viewer: Reads orders, production and deliveries; changes nothing.
roleLine.customer-admin: Everything of the customer portal, and their colleagues' access.
roleLine.supplier-orders: Purchase orders to confirm, ship notices and deliveries.
roleLine.supplier-invoices: Their invoices and our payments, without prices on orders.
roleLine.supplier-admin: Everything of the supplier portal, and their colleagues' access.
roleLine.subcontractor-jobs: Jobs to accept, kits received, progress and send-backs.
roleLine.subcontractor-admin: Everything of the workshop portal, and their colleagues' access.
roleLine.guest-accountant: The accounting exports, for a limited time.
roleLine.partner-comment: Writes messages on what they can see.
roleLine.partner-upload: Sends files on what they can see.
roleLine.partner-approve: Approves, accepts or signs what we ask.

capabilityLine.approve: May approve, accept or sign what we ask.

right.manage: Change partner people's access and the portal's switches

terms.missing: The portal terms of this company are not published yet: nobody can be invited before (the privacy gate).

settings.title: Portal

intro.customers: Whether {name} has a customer portal, how many people it holds and which roles it offers.
intro.suppliers: Whether {name} has a supplier portal, how many people it holds and which roles it offers. Links sent for one order work without it.

settings.portalOnHint: Their people can sign in, see what is theirs and get our e-mails.
settings.portalOffHint: Off: nobody of theirs signs in and nothing reaches them from the portal; links still work.
settings.maxUsersHint: Empty: no limit. {taken} invited or active now.
settings.maxRange: A number from 1 to 1000, or empty for no limit.
settings.maxBelowTaken: {taken} people are invited or active: deactivate some first, or give a number of at least {taken}.
settings.rolesAll: Every role of the portal is offered. Untick the ones they may not give.
settings.rolesSome: Only the ticked roles are offered to new people; people keep a role taken off the list.
settings.unsaved_one: 1 change to the portal not saved
settings.unsaved_other: {count} changes to the portal not saved

preview.title: What they see

intro.customers: Open the portal exactly as {name} sees it, without signing in as them.
intro.suppliers: Open the portal exactly as {name} sees it, without signing in as them.

preview.readOnly: Read-only: nothing can be sent, approved or changed from it, and no price shows.
preview.hour: It opens in a new tab and ends after an hour.
preview.recorded: Every preview is recorded in the audit log.
preview.whileOff: Their portal is off: you see what they would see once it is on.

people.title: People with access

intro.customers: Who at this customer may sign in to the portal, with which role, until when.
intro.suppliers: Supplier contacts invited to the portal, with which role, until when.

people.noPricesLine: Supplier and workshop roles never see a price.

empty.customers: Nobody from this customer uses the portal

emptyHint.customers: Invite the first person: they get an e-mail and sign in with a code.
emptyHint.suppliers: Links still work without an account. Invite a contact to give them the portal.

resend.title_other: Send the invitation to {count} people again?
resend.body: A new invitation e-mail goes out, valid for 7 days, with the same role and end of access; the old link stops.

revoke.body: The invitation link stops working at once and the person is deactivated. Invite them again to give access.

suspend.body: Their sessions end now and they cannot sign in until reactivated. Their role and end of access stay.

reactivate.body: They can sign in again with the role they had.

deactivate.body: Their sessions end now, their roles end and they cannot sign in again. Their name stays on what they did.

confirm.skipped_one: 1 chosen person is left out: the action does not apply to them.
confirm.skipped_other: {count} chosen people are left out: the action does not apply to them.

done.until: The end of access of {name} is saved.
done.preview: The portal of {name} opened in a new tab, read-only, for an hour.
done.production: The production limits of {name} are saved.
done.productionAndSupervisor: The production limits and the supervisor of {name} are saved.
done.freeze: The freeze rule of {name} is saved.
done.freezeReset: {name} follows the company’s freeze points for this field again.
done.previewProduction: My production of {name} opened in a new tab, read-only, for an hour.

invite.title: Invite someone from {name}
invite.hint: They get an e-mail and sign in with a code; no password.
invite.name: Name
invite.kindNeeded: Choose which portal the person is for.
invite.noRoles: This portal offers no role: tick one under Roles offered first.
invite.untilHint: Their access ends at the end of that day. Empty: no end.
invite.untilGuest: An adviser's access always ends: give the day.
invite.guestNeedsEnd: An adviser's access always ends: give the day.
invite.language: Language of the invitation and the portal
invite.exists: This address already has access to this portal.
invite.roleNotOffered: This portal does not offer that role.

person.title: Access of {name}
person.untilHint: Their access ends at the end of that day. Empty: no end.
person.invitedNote: Not signed in yet: the change applies to their open invitation.

requests.title: Requests waiting for them
requests.intro: What we asked of them through the portal and still waits for their answer.
requests.cancelBody: It leaves their list and stops the reminders. Asking again makes a new request.
requests.emptyHint: Requests from orders, purchase orders and documents show here, and the ones you ask for.

ask.title: Ask {name} for something
ask.hint: The request shows in their portal with a reminder before the date. Say the details in the organisation's messages.

kindLine.UPLOAD_DOCUMENT: A certificate, a declaration or a file we need from them.
kindLine.ANSWER_MESSAGE: A question we wrote them in the messages.
kindLine.SEND_MEASUREMENTS: Body measurements for a made-to-measure order.

tileHint.endsSoon: Within 7 days; they were told by e-mail

partners.empty: No partner uses a portal yet
partners.emptyHint: Invite customers and suppliers from their Portal access tab (Sales › Customers, Purchasing › Suppliers).
partners.inviteWhere: A partner is invited from their organisation's Portal access tab: Sales › Customers or Purchasing › Suppliers.

org.title: Organisation
org.intro: Which customer or supplier this person belongs to, and their access there.
org.noAdminHint: The factory manages their colleagues meanwhile.
org.pricesAtMost: Partners see prices at most; never costs or margins.
org.changeHint: A new end of access, or remove them from the organisation.
org.changeInvited: Not signed in yet: the end applies to their open invitation; Remove revokes it.
org.removeBody: Their sessions end now, their roles end and they cannot sign in again. Their name stays on what they did.
org.notFound: This person is not in the organisation any more
org.notFoundHint: Read the page again; they may have been moved by someone else.

limits.title: Production
limits.intro: What {name} sees of its orders in production and what it may do there. Everything starts off: Status only, no urgent orders, no production requests.
limits.readFailed: The production limits could not be read.
limits.presetHint: Production partner fills + Progress, urgent orders on (at most 3) and every production request in one click; Apply saves it.
limits.presetFilled: Production partner filled in: + Progress, urgent orders on (at most 3), every production request. Apply to save.

preview.saveFirst: Save first: the preview shows the saved limits.

limits.portalOff: Their portal is off: these limits apply once it is on. A supervisor works without a portal: saving one opens nothing for them.
limits.limitsSavedNotSupervisor: The limits are saved; the supervisor was not changed.

sees.title: What {name} sees
sees.always: Every level shows the stage, the expected date and its moves, health, who acts next, holds and requests. Also:

levelLine.STATUS: The stage, the expected date and its moves, health and who acts next. The start for every customer.
levelLine.PROGRESS: + the pieces of each line and size: cut, sewn, checked, packed.
levelLine.GATES: + their gates (PP sample, size set, leather, trims, lab) with planned and done dates, from the published plan only.
levelLine.QUALITY: + inspection results and photos of their own goods (work orders of theirs alone).

urgency.label: Urgent orders
urgency.rule: They mark their own orders urgent. Inside the limit and before Cutting a mark counts at once; over the limit, or from Cutting on, a mark becomes a request we answer. Back to regular is always free.
urgency.offHint: Off: they cannot mark orders urgent.
urgency.maxHint: At most {max} urgent at once · {now} urgent now.

asks.title: Production requests they may make
asks.rules: “Urgent – asked” comes with Urgent orders. Changes and cancels follow the company’s cut-offs, not this list.
asks.openNone: Their Ask menu offers no production request now.

ask.SPLIT_SHIPMENT: Ask to ship what is ready

askLine.HOLD: They ask us to pause an order; we accept or refuse.
askLine.RESUME: They ask us to go on with an order paused at their request.
askLine.SPLIT_SHIPMENT: They ask us to ship what is ready now and the rest later.
askLine.SAMPLE_ROUND: They ask for one more sample round before production.

approver.title: Who answers on their side
approver.inactiveSaved: {name} is no longer active: it counts as nobody named until you pick another.
approver.none: Nobody of theirs is active in the portal yet: invite someone first.
approver.covers: For their production approvals: PP sample, size set, top of production, fabric and trims. Artwork stays with their Designers, concessions with their Quality.

approverLine.ANYONE: Every person of theirs who may approve answers.
approverLine.NAMED: Only this person answers; the others read “Waiting for” and the name.

fourEyes.title: Overrides need a second person
fourEyes.label: A second person
fourEyes.onHint: On: when we decide for {name} or undo what they did, a second person of ours grants it.
fourEyes.offHint: Off: whoever holds the override right decides for {name} alone, with a reason they read.

freeze.title: Freeze points
freeze.intro: From which production stage a field of their orders freezes, at {company}. Their own rules replace the company’s for that field.
freeze.failed: The freeze points could not be read.
freeze.noCompany: Open this customer from one company to see its freeze points.

dialog.title: Freeze of {field} for {name}
dialog.noteHint: One line, at most 200 characters; they read it on the order.
dialog.resetHint: Back to the company’s switches their own rules of this field off: the company’s decide again.
dialog.atOnce: A rule is saved at once, apart from Apply.

problem.twin: They have a rule of their own from this stage already: switch it off first.
problem.loosens: After a block, a later stage cannot open the field again for a priced change.
problem.note: The words are one line of at most 200 characters.

supervisor.title: Who looks after {name} here
supervisor.intro: Never in their portal or the preview, and they are not told who it is. Shown while their portal is off too: a supervisor needs no portal.
supervisor.label: Production supervisor
supervisor.backupHint: Gets the unanswered problems after 1 working day.
supervisor.moves_one: Changing the supervisor moves {count} order that has no supervisor of its own.
supervisor.moves_other: Changing the supervisor moves {count} orders that have no supervisor of their own.
supervisor.clears_one: {count} order without a supervisor of its own will have none.
supervisor.clears_other: {count} orders without a supervisor of their own will have none.
supervisor.movesNone: No open order follows the customer default now.
supervisor.backupAlone: A backup comes only beside a supervisor.
supervisor.backupSame: The backup is another person than the supervisor.
supervisor.heldEveryCompany: Setting this customer’s supervisor needs the right to manage its production at every company it works with.
supervisor.readFailed: Who may supervise could not be read.

problem.nothing: Nothing changes: these are the limits already.
